paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: : WMT15 De
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the BLEU score performance of four different models as a function of Average Lagging (AL) on the WMT15 De dataset. The x-axis represents Average Lagging (AL), ranging from 0 to 7, with a linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 2. The y-axis represents BLEU score, ranging from 12 to 28, also on a linear scale with tick marks at intervals of 2. Four lines are plotted: a red solid line with star markers labeled "Consistency-Bi", a blue dashed line with square markers labeled "Inconsistency-CE-MP", a purple dashed line with circle markers labeled "Consistency-CE", and a dark purple dashed line with square markers labeled "Inconsistency-CE". The red line starts at approximately 23 BLEU at AL=0 and increases steadily to about 28 BLEU at AL=7. The blue dashed line begins at approximately 19 BLEU at AL=0 and rises to about 27 BLEU at AL=7. The purple dashed line starts at 12 BLEU at AL=0 and increases to around 26 BLEU at AL=7. The dark purple dashed line starts at approximately 19 BLEU at AL=0 and rises to about 26 BLEU at AL=7. All lines show an increasing trend in BLEU score with increasing AL, with the red line consistently achieving the highest BLEU scores across all AL values.
